items.label: Fe-Zr binary alloy samples
items.quote: High-purity starting materials (99.99 wt.%) were used to prepare the Fe-Zr binary alloy samples in the present work. All samples were prepared by arc-melting under an Ar atmosphere of high purity. The arc furnace chamber was evacuated and flushed with pure Ar at least four times. A piece of pure Ti was re-melted at least four times before alloying in order to consume any residual oxygen. To ensure composition homogeneity, all samples were inverted and re-melted at least five times. The ingots of which burning losses did not exceed 1 wt.% were used in the subsequent experiments.
items.synthesis: arc-melting under an Ar atmosphere of high purity

items.quote: The enthalpy and temperature of fusion, as well as the temperature of invariant reactions were determined experimentally by differential thermal analysis.
